text: As of 5 Sept. 2017, 3713 publications resulting from research and communication funded by the NCP, have been added to the NCP Publications Database. This includes 1256 papers in the Synopsis of Research volumes, 1008 journal papers, and 1449 other publications.
Publications available on the Web are hyperlinked: 1459 records have URLs that take you directly to the PDF files of the publications.

932 of the 1008 journal papers have DOIs (digital object identifiers) or URLs, which are hyperlinked. Clicking on the link will take you to the publisher's website and, if your organization has a subscription, to a PDF file of the paper.

To make the NCP Publications Database as complete as possible, NCP-funded researchers can help by reporting their publications to astis@ucalgary.ca.

The Northern Contaminants Program requests all NCP Researchers obtain an Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID). ORCIDs provide a way to uniquely identify researchers' records in Canadian polar databases and will allow easy cross-linking of records between the NCP’s website and the NCP Publications Database. They are also increasingly being required for publication submission. To obtain your own ORCID identifier, please register at http://orcid.org and send your 16 digit identifier to astis@ucalgary.ca.
